article.name: Fees
article.title: Fees
article.body:
While many of our competitors charge varying premiums based on transaction size, we have decided to provide our lowest possible premium to everyone, regardless of the purchase amount.  We also do not charge a transaction fee. OneGold customers can buy, sell, and redeem 24/7, free of transaction fees, even if the markets are closed.

For current product premiums, please see our Products Page.
